title: WAGO 221 lever connector, snap clip
summary: A WAGO 221 lever connector held flat on the floor. Push it down between two arms: they flex out over the sloped lead-ins and hook over its top edge at each short end. Corner stops locate it; the wire-entry face stays open. 2, 3 and 5 way, 4 mm² and 6 mm², selected by item number.

views.label: How it goes in
views.caption: Drag the slider to push the 221-415 down into the clip: the arms spread over the lead-ins, then the hooks snap over the top at each end. Wires go in from the open face on the left.

views.label: On a carrier
views.caption: The 221-415's clip on a 3 × 5 carrier (30 × 50), screwed down at its corners, the plate opened under the body. Drag the slider to push the WAGO down: the arms spread over the lead-ins and the hooks snap over its top at each end. The screw heads sit beside the corner stops, clear of the body, so the carrier goes down first and the WAGO clips in after. To take it out, prise one hook back with a fingernail and lift; the carrier stays screwed down.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: Four clips for a 221-415 on an open floor, marked with 1 to 4 engraved dots: three hook depths, and a tighter fit round the body.
